# The Bogey Club

> Golf simulator sports bar and event space at 17705 Leslie Street, Unit 5, Newmarket, Ontario L3Y 3E3, Canada, serving Newmarket, Aurora, East Gwillimbury, Bradford and York Region. Four Golfzon golf simulators (two TwoVision NX, two Vision Plus). The bar side and its two staffed bays are open daily 9 AM to 12 AM; two automated bays can be booked online and played 24/7. Fully licensed, with two full bars serving draft beer and cocktails. Phone (905) 235-4653, golf@thebogeyclub.com.

## Key facts

- Simulators: 4 Golfzon bays (2 TwoVision NX, 2 Vision Plus), up to 4 players per bay, more than 200 courses plus driving range and practice modes.
- Hours: bar side and 2 staffed bays daily 9 AM to 12 AM; 2 automated bays bookable and playable 24/7.
- Bay rates (per bay, per hour, plus HST): Overnight 12 AM to 9 AM on automated bays $49.99; Off-peak Mon to Thu 9 AM to 5 PM $49.99; Standard Mon to Thu 5 PM to close, Fri 9 AM to 4 PM and all day Sun $59.99; Peak Fri 4 PM to close, all day Sat and holidays $69.99.
- Booking: online at https://thebogeyclub.golfbooking.ca/calendar.php or by phone.
- Also: karaoke, private parties and corporate events in an upstairs space with its own full bar, golf leagues (Men's Night on Tuesdays, The Bogey Cup monthly), private lessons with a PGA of Canada professional.
